$comment: Render scale and upscaling (docs/DEV_TOOLS.md, Render scale and upscaling; ARCHITECTURE.md §6.10). The scene is drawn at one of `scales` of the screen's pixels per axis and upscaled by one of `upscalers`, a fixed vocabulary the renderer knows (dwell-client render/upscale.rs `Upscaler`). Settings → Graphics offers them; ?renderscale= and ?upscaler= override them for a visit (the bench). `sharpenStops` is the sharpen's strength in stops (0 the strongest, FSR 1's RCAS).

upscalers.label: Stretch
upscalers.hint: The browser stretches a smaller canvas (bilinear): the cheapest, softer

upscalers.label: Sharpen
upscalers.hint: An edge-adaptive upscale and a sharpen (FSR 1 style) on a full-size canvas: crisper, one more pass
